motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council INSTRUCT the Chief Legislative Analyst, with the assistance of the Department of Recreation and Parks, Los Angeles Police Department, and City Administrative Officer, to report on options for establishing a permanent Park Gate Closure Program, including the feasibility and operational and fiscal impacts of transferring responsibility for park gate closures or other appropriate alternatives, and any staffing, resources, or implementation measures necessary to ensure City parks are consistently secured. PRESENTED BY: SECONDED BY: mwaatokali— MONICA RODRIGUEZ ) • Councilwoman, 7th District M— AUG 2 5 2026
title: Permanent Park Gate Closure Program / Operational and Fiscal Impacts / Implementation Measures

requests.asks: Report on options for establishing a permanent Park Gate Closure Program, including feasibility, operational and fiscal impacts, and staffing and resource requirements to ensure City parks are consistently secured.
